description: The watcher saw the catalog move (S66 T3): which skills arrived, left, or changed shape since the last refresh, plus the honest watch state — watching is false and watchError names the reason whenever the daemon is partly or fully blind. An event with no names in any list is a refresh that found nothing new and is never sent.

payload.watchError: the managed root is not there to watch (/srv/aeon/skills) — a root created later is discovered by the next scan
